verdict.rationale: Adyen documents referenced refunds, which return money to the original payment, and unreferenced refunds, which return any amount to any card presented. Refunds can be issued through the Terminal API at the point of sale and from the Customer Area dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of partial-amount referenced refunds back to the original card, details of the refund flow beyond one-line mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
